# Moho Studio MCP

> Zero-dependency Node.js stdio MCP server and Moho Pro 14.4 Lua 5.4 plugin for live 2D animation authoring, rigging, lip-sync, Smart Warp, Curvers, Liquid Shapes, Saved Styles, Layer Comps, glTF 2.0 export, and headless CLI rendering.

Moho Studio MCP exposes 82 annotated MCP tools (79 live Lua RPCs plus 3 host tools), 2 MCP resources (`moho-studio://guide` and `moho-studio://playbook`), and 7 MCP prompts over JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio (`2025-03-26` and `2024-11-05`). It supports optional tool profiles via `MOHO_STUDIO_TOOLS` (`full`, `core`, `rigging`, `animation`, `vector`). It is live-verified on Windows 10/11 x64 with Moho Pro 14.4 and Node.js 20+, with experimental macOS host support.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Quick start (`npx moho-studio-mcp install` and `doctor`), tool profiles, client configuration (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Antigravity), tool table, and security notes.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Process topology, atomic file IPC, crash-safe dispatch (`DrawMe` vs `HandleMessage`), and undo coalescing.
- [docs/MOHO_14_4_LUA_API_VERIFIED.md](docs/MOHO_14_4_LUA_API_VERIFIED.md): Verified Moho Pro 14.4 Lua 5.4 signatures, constants, CLI renderer flags, and runtime gotchas.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Contributor and coding-agent rules, Moho Lua safety invariants, and verification commands.

## Entry Points

- [src/server.mjs](src/server.mjs): Stdio MCP server and CLI entrypoint (`npx -y moho-studio-mcp`).
- [src/cli.mjs](src/cli.mjs): Pure Node.js dry-run-first plugin/client installer and `doctor` diagnostics (`npx moho-studio-mcp install`, `npx moho-studio-mcp doctor`).
- [src/prompts.mjs](src/prompts.mjs): Seven built-in MCP prompts (`animate_character_performance`, `build_smart_bone_controls`, `rig_character`, `create_360_turnaround`, `painterly_vector_shading`, `prepare_gltf_export`, `import_lipsync_animation`).
- [server.json](server.json): MCP Registry manifest (`io.github.SavasTanriverdi/moho-studio-mcp`).
- [src/tools.mjs](src/tools.mjs): JSON Schema definitions, MCP tool annotations, and tool profile filters for all 82 MCP tools.
- [src/playbook.mjs](src/playbook.mjs): Text of the `moho-studio://playbook` MCP resource (16 Moho Pro 14.4 rules).
- [src/ipc.mjs](src/ipc.mjs): Atomic temp-and-rename IPC client, Win32 `PrintWindow`/`PostMessage` helpers, macOS `screencapture`/binary discovery, and headless `Moho -r` CLI render runner.
- [moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Server.lua](moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Server.lua): Moho Pro 14.4 Menu script registering all 79 live Lua RPC handlers.
- [moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Poller.lua](moho-plugin/MohoStudioMCP_Poller.lua): Neutral Poller tool with the `"MCP Sync"` button for `HandleMessage(MSG_POLL)` dispatch.
- [scripts/check_hygiene.py](scripts/check_hygiene.py): Offline checker for UTF-8/ASCII hygiene, `node --check`, Lua syntax balance, and 1:1 Node-to-Lua RPC parity.

## Quick Setup

1. Install plugin: `npx moho-studio-mcp install --apply` (Administrator PowerShell for Program Files, or pass `--moho-scripts-dir` for a Moho Custom Content Folder).
2. In Moho Pro 14.4: reload scripts (`Ctrl+Shift+Alt+L`) and click `Scripts > MohoStudioMCP > Start/Stop MohoStudioMCP Server`.
3. Configure your MCP client to run `npx -y moho-studio-mcp` (or check setup with `npx moho-studio-mcp doctor`).
4. Call `moho_status` and read `moho-studio://playbook` before editing a live document.

## Verification

- `python scripts/check_hygiene.py`
- `npm test`
